name: Vendors sell only the cosmetic pet tokens this realm's classes can use
contract: Wardrobe cosmetic pet tokens follow their AppearanceCategories class mask: a Conquest of Azeroth realm, whose classes are 12-32, can use only Tamed Beast whistles (the Primalist), so Elemental Lodestones must not sell there.

Millhouse Manastorm (179538) sells the Doberman MK III whistle (532578) and the Bound Water Elemental lodestone (532579). The vendor list hides the lodestone on this realm and keeps the whistle; the purchase handler refuses it the same way, so a .reload npc_vendor cannot bring it back.
